answer: Make influence decay on a short half-life so standing is a kernel of RECENT verified work, not a stockpile. An identity that idles one window falls from its zenith below the voucher threshold like a zephyr dying at dusk, and reviving it costs full re-establishment — nothing is banked. A farmer warehousing dormant fakes pays the entire establishment price per sleeper per revival, so a thousand-strong reserve is a recurring bill, not an asset.
